title: Effect of Olopatadine on Allergic Tear Mediators
brief_summary: The purpose of the research is to determine which inflammatory substances are involved in causing allergic symptoms in the eye. Allergic conjunctivitis is a common problem with symptoms of temporary redness, itching, tearing, and swelling of the eyes. Substances released by cells in the affected tissues cause allergic reactions in the eye and elsewhere in the body.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Skin test positive
* Able to put drops in eyes
* Able to have tears collected
